correctness.rationale: Comparing two deletion starts i<j after removing the common prefix and suffix shows the outputs coincide precisely when all lag-b comparisons from i+1 through j are equalities. Each fiber is an interval, so the count is one plus the lag-b mismatches. Distinct edges are pairwise independent, including edges with a shared endpoint, proving the two-length covariance and means. At L=a+b the lag graph is the disjoint union of cycles of addition by a modulo L, one per residue mod g=gcd(a,b). The earliest whole cycle has last vertex L−g+1. At that length the other residues are intact paths (at most one vertex was removed per cycle), and for n>L every extra vertex attaches to its own residue component, so the cycle rank is max(0,n−L+g). In the forest regime all edge indicators jointly factor by root-first exposure. Outside it, the probability of all endpoint equalities is q^(κ−n); division by q^(a−n)q^(b−n) proves the exact certificate and excludes independence. In the three-length expansion every forest term vanishes; each triangle contributes −(q−1)/q³ for mismatches. The extreme positions have gap c, so the two possible middle positions exist exactly at c=a+b and give 2(n−c) triangles. Direct enumeration independently corroborated every pair joint table and triple centered moment for (q,n)=(2,10),(2,11),(5,5), outside the supplied grid. Replay: python3 branches/independent_checks.py 1 (standard library).
residual_risks: The strict threshold is about two full cardinalities; zero third moment for a nonresonant triple does not entail independence. The phrase ‘first nonzero’ should be read only for resonant triples; the displayed formula does not assert a nonzero third moment for every triple. Bounded enumeration is not an all-length proof.

Forests give equality. This is a finite algebraic identity in a paper whose main limit theorems are asymptotic.
Schoeny et al. give the binary one-length count and shifted-binomial law in their b-divides-n setting; Song and Cai supply coding context rather than the joint law.

Fine–Wilf is a plausible period-overlap antecedent; the primary DOI returned no accessible proof passage. The cited joint-count comparison and the primary graph-coloring identity do not rely on that retrieval.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The product identity is exactly the required broader finite result for joint indicators, not a marginal binomial law or only an asymptotic approximation. The known one-length law alone cannot distinguish pair dependence.

evidence: The tandem record's §3 identifies each residue-class cycle and its final vertex, so it counts complete cycles for n≤L. For n>L the lag-a edge to an earlier vertex keeps each added vertex in the same residue class; from n=L the graph has exactly g components. Together with |E|=2n−L this gives cycle rank max(0,n−L+g) for all n.
The primary product identity for all edges gives q^(−|E|+β); multiplying the individual lag-path all-equality probabilities and taking the ratio gives q^β exactly.

With three edges of distinct lengths the only nonforest is a triangle. On a triangle the q^(−|V|+ν) rule gives q^−2 for all equalities; after centering (pair products factor) the mismatch product has expectation −(q^−2−q^−3). Substituting the line positions gives 2(n−c) triangles for c=a+b and zero otherwise.

originality.rationale: The strongest indexed tandem-duplication result is not merely a parameter match: its exact distinct-descendant count equals the frozen burst-deletion count pointwise on every source word. This proves equivalent coverage of the two-length covariance and independence theorem, with the same lag-graph cycle decomposition. The simultaneous-minimum ratio is the all-equalities specialization of the verified arbitrary-graph product-moment identity, with cycle rank from that decomposition (and unchanged residue connectivity after n=a+b). The three-length formula likewise specializes the published graph-coloring edge-product identity to three edges: only triangles contribute, and the two orders of the inner lag on a line give the factor 2(n−c). No independent substantive part of the stated result remains. The indexed comparison is dated later and demonstrates present equivalent coverage, not earlier priority; the primary graph-coloring identity predates the record.
residual_risks: The searches do not resolve historical priority between the equivalently formulated counts. The frozen-title web query was uninformative; the decision rests instead on direct mathematical comparison and the inspected finite graph moment identity.

value.rationale: Quantifying when two burst cardinalities cannot be modeled as independent is a natural question. But its main law transfers unchanged from the pointwise identical tandem count, and the ratio and additive mixed moment use direct cycle-rank and triangle substitutions into the known product formula. Converting the output interpretation or naming the additive case does not leave a separate exact fact requiring new mathematical work.
residual_risks: This does not deny the application value of the known identities for joint burst-channel modeling.
